Title: Antimalarial activity from OSM
Description: Scores triazolopyrazine analogues for antiplasmodial potency, trained by Ersilia on the roughly 400 Open Source Malaria Series 4 compounds whose IC50 values the consortium published as they were measured. Two LazyQSAR classifiers use activity cut-offs of 1 and 2.5 micromolar, reaching AUROC above 0.8 in cross-validation. Predictors from this campaign guided the generative rounds reported by Turon and colleagues, and of eight compounds eventually synthesised four were submicromolar. Coverage is deepest around Series 4 chemistry.
Interpretation: Probability of Plasmodium falciparum inhibition at two IC50 cut-offs, 1 uM and 2.5 uM, reported separately.
